transcript.speaker: Heard
transcript.text: Hi, I’m Gogo. RoomPilot turns live conversations into the next useful move.

transcript.speaker: Heard
transcript.text: I’m Camille. I work with founder programs, so I see event follow-up problems all the time.

transcript.speaker: Gogo
transcript.text: Nice. How has the hackathon been for you?

transcript.speaker: Camille
transcript.text: Intense, but good. The projects are strong.

transcript.speaker: Gogo
transcript.text: I built RoomPilot today, but I don’t want it to become another weekend project.

transcript.speaker: Camille
transcript.text: That happens a lot. The demo works, people say it’s cool, then Monday comes and nobody knows who to talk to.

transcript.speaker: Camille
transcript.text: The real risk is that the demo dies after the weekend.

transcript.speaker: Gogo
transcript.text: Exactly. Who would care enough to try this next week?

transcript.speaker: Camille
transcript.text: I’d talk to someone at Hexa. They see founder meetings and event follow-up problems every week.

transcript.speaker: Gogo
transcript.text: Who at Hexa should I talk to first?

transcript.speaker: Camille
transcript.text: Maybe Nick. I’m not sure he owns it, but he’d know who does.

transcript.speaker: Gogo
transcript.text: Great. What should I ask without sounding too pitchy?

transcript.speaker: Camille
transcript.text: Say you tested it live at Tech Europe and want to know if it helps founders avoid losing useful conversations.

transcript.speaker: Gogo
transcript.text: Perfect. Thanks, Camille. Good luck with the demos.

transcript.speaker: Camille
transcript.text: You too. I’ll send Nick’s contact if I find it.
